title: Operational area
description: The front matter of an operational area under .ai/repo/why/areas/: one part of running AI-assisted work that moments are filed under, and that a diagnosis reports a reader's load in. The body carries what the area covers and what it does not. An area never lists its moments: membership is each moment's `areas`, and every list and count is derived.

schema.description: The format version of this record. A version the tool does not know is refused, never guessed.

id.description: The identity and the slug. It fixes the file name and the route /why/areas/<id>/.

title.description: The area, named as a part of operations rather than as a feature.

summary.description: One line: what falls under it. Also the page description.

weight.description: Presentation order within a listing, lowest first.
